finality: Both boundaries at or below first finalized head; all16 parent links and end hash rechecked after capture. No outcome if changed.
coverage: One block per page, eth_getBlockReceipts exact transaction hash/index set equals block.transactions, no duplicate logs or removed logs. Missing page, endpoint error, truncated response, mismatched chain/hash/status -> DATA_MISSING. No range changes.
eligibility: Successful status1 receipt; exact hook HookSwap plus ProtocolFeesCollected recipient TokenJar. ERC20: pair each fee one-to-one with PoolManager -> TokenJar Transfer of identical token/raw amount in that receipt. Native fees remain event claims without execution traces.
units: Unsigned uint256 atomic units; decimals eth_call at frozen end block, values integer/string only. Report each token separately, no invented USD conversion.
uni_attribution: Canonical UNI Transfer to Firepit.RESOURCE_RECIPIENT plus Firepit Released log proves shared-jar conversion only. Never allocate all shared-jar UNI to the selected hook. Approval/allowance/proposals do not count. Sink transfer is not totalSupply reduction.
direct_value: Measured per-token gross direct transfer to jar; complete-zero only with full fixed-range receipts. Incomplete -> null plus observed lower bound.

causal_increment.reason: Replacement/counterfactual unknown; never substitute gross or zero for UNI-90d causal net increment.

duplicate_key: chain_id:block_hash:transaction_hash:log_index; observation id also binds spec and metric. Same capture replay creates no domain records.
legacy_predictions: No forecast/decision/resolution mutations. All12 retain original policy attribution and timing. Progress observations are not training outcomes.
